entities.summary: Ban on proprietary trading by commercial banks, whereby deposits are used to trade on the bank's own accounts, although a number of exceptions to this ban were included in the dodd-frank law. Volcker Rule is a statute from Americas. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
